name: Wedge Design Car
summary: The car as a low wedge. A pointed nose, a flat bonnet that rises to a high tail and a long straight crease along the flank. It has pop-up lamps and sharp, flat panels with matte black trim.

philosophy.core_thesis: A fast car cuts the air as a blade does. It has one straight line from a low nose to a high tail, with flat panels and sharp creases.
design_principles: Draw one straight line from a low nose to a high tail, at a rise of 8 to 12 degrees.
Keep the body very low, with a height of 1.05 to 1.15 m.
Make the panels flat and join them in sharp creases, with a strong line at the waist.
Hide the headlamps in the nose, and open them in pop-up pods.
Slope the windscreen at a very low angle, and run the glass in a long wedge to the tail.
Use matte black trim, black louvres and black wheel arches to cut the body into planes.
Trim the cabin in cord, velour or plaid, with a flat dashboard of black plastic and rows of small switches.
anti_patterns: Round, soft curves and a bulbous tail
A tall roof and a short, flat nose
Tail fins on the rear wings

silhouette.shape: A very low wedge: a sharp nose, a straight flat bonnet and a roof line that rises in one slope to a high, short tail.
silhouette.line: A single straight crease from the nose to the tail, and a flat shoulder over a narrow glass area.
silhouette.fit: Two seats, laid back, close to the floor; the cabin is tight and the roof is low.
silhouette.proportion: Height 1.05 to 1.15 m; width 1.8 to 2 m; length 4.2 to 4.5 m; nose height about 60 percent of the tail height.
rules: Set the windscreen at a very low angle, merged with the bonnet.
Cut the flank with one sharp crease and a deep air intake behind the door.
Hide each headlamp in a pop-up pod in the flat nose.
Fit big, flat rear glass or a louvred panel, and a wide, flat tail with a row of lamps.

fabrics.rule: Use flat panels of sheet aluminium or glass-fibre, black plastic for the trim, and hard-wearing cloth or vinyl in the cabin.

methods: flat panels creased on a straight line
glass-fibre body moulded over a steel backbone
aluminium panels formed on a flat press
pop-up headlamp pods driven by an electric motor
black plastic trim moulded and clipped
paint in one flat, bright colour
construction.closures: Doors that open up, as scissor doors, or that hinge at the front on a flat panel; a flush handle or a recessed catch.
construction.details: Pop-up headlamps, a long wedge of glass and black louvres over the engine. The dash is flat with a row of switches. The tail panel is wide and flat.

surface.pattern: Plain body colour with a thin stripe, black trim, and cord or plaid in the cabin.
surface.gloss: Metallic paint at 70–85 GU; matte black trim at 5–10 GU; the glass is dark and flat.
surface.wear: Pop-up motors fail, the black trim fades to grey, and the velour wears at the seat edge.

palette.strategy: A bright, flat colour such as yellow, red or white, cut by matte black trim, and a dark cabin of cord or plaid.

processes: a flat-panel design drawn at a design house
making.scale: Small series of a few hundred to a few thousand cars, at Italian and British makers; some one-off show cars.
making.signs: A low nose, a straight crease, pop-up lamps, flat panels, matte black trim and a cabin of cord or plaid.

pieces.form: Low mid-engine wedge with scissor doors and a flat tail
Glass-fibre wedge coupe with pop-up lamps and a long glass slope
Sharp-edged hatchback with flat panels and a straight crease
Flat black dash with a row of switches and round dials
Cord or plaid bucket seats with a bold, simple pattern

emotion.target_response: A sense of speed and of the future. The viewer sees a sharp, flat blade of a car that looks cut from one sheet.

use_cases: a poster or a film set in the 1970s and 1980s
an image prompt for a low, sharp car
avoid_when: the brief wants a soft, rounded body
the brief wants a family or a luxury saloon
the brief wants chrome and fins

modifiers.how: Round every edge, merge the lamps into the body and paint the bumpers in the body colour.
Curve the panels, lift the nose, add thin chrome and a wood-rim wheel.

ornament_level.note: The wedge shape is the ornament; trim is black and plain.
